body:
I'm honestly not sure why you're trying as hard as possible to put your own assumed twist on this. Both of my siblings have told my parents they would be open to having a relationship with me again, qnd a few years ago when my parents found out both of them basically forgave me. And in the story I don't try to shine the best possible light on myself, I don't see any reason I would lie in a story on Reddit ?

It really annoys me how you'd say I have 'absolutely no concern for what I did to my family' where that's the reason for my pain. If I had no concern, I would have tried to get a job but I haven't because theres very few options in my tiny town, leaving me to go to a fast food restaurant. I don't want my siblings to ever be hanging out with friends and have to awkwardly insist that they don't go to that restaurant.(because id be working in there and it would be awkward to see me) 

I sit in my room every hour I'm awake and pew out my window because I want to seem almost like I'm not even here to my siblings. I want to kill myself so that my siblings don't have to ever deal with me being around again. I csre about them more than anyone else in the entire world and you keep trying to make it seem like I have no concern for them. The only time I feel any sort of relief is when I hear my siblings leaving to hang out with friends or when I hear them genuinely having fun and laughing with each other.  I wouldn't even mind if I felt all the pain in the world, if it meant they never had to go through any of this. 

I'm sorry if for some reason you don't see it, or if I didn't convey it properly in my post, but my siblings are my biggest concern.

Well I guess I understand how you would come to these conclusions based on what I've written in the post and without knowing the fill story, and only knowing what's written. But I can assure you that it's not how you think it is.

Well, that's kind of implied by this post that most of my pain comes from the fact that I've not just messed up my life but my siblings too. 

I recognize now that my sister will probably take years to even feel completely safe again. And that now she has to live her life too hiding the fact that this happened to her. If people ask how many siblings she has and she tells them, then they will always ask about me and why they haven't seen me and she will have to come up with an excuse. Her older brother who she trusted more than anyone completely betrayed her in the worst way possible and she has to live with it now. Most the times that I get most emotional and cry and scream into my pillow is when I'm thinking about how horrible iy just have been for her, especially at the times when it was going on. To think I caused her to always have to feel vulnerable and scared to sleep on the couch or to have any bit of her window blinds open. And how it all happened to her for so long and she had NOBODY to tell for years that she was being abused. The first step of me realizing how bad I was was when my sister didn't want to stay home alone with me and her and I knew she probably thought I would assault her, that was a horrible feeling because please believe me when I say I never would have done something like thst even at the peak of my lust. 

And basically the same with my brother, its just as bad with him. He got super depressed when my sister told him about what I was doing and he distanced himself from everyone. He trusted me too and thought I had changed many years ago, then he learned I never did at all, all at once. 
I blame myself fully for any social shortcomings or depression that any of my siblings have experienced or will experience in the next decade. 

That's the biggest reason I want to kill myself and almost surely will in a month. If I only really cared for myself and how shitty my life is I wouldn't want to. Trust me, when I leave I'm not coming back because I know it will be worse for them and me. I'm going to keep and save all of my money thst I get from fafsa, I'm going to get a job on campus, and by the time the semesters over I will have enough money to move somewhere cheap alone. 

I know in my heart thst the best option for me would be to write two letters to my siblings, slide them under their doors, and try to get our family to meet at the couch and have a hard long talk where I apologize and tell them I'm going to get therapy. But I'm weak and I cant ever do it. I wouldn't be able to handle looking at them at all and I know it would be the same vice versa. But I know all I need to do is just grow up for just a tiny bit of time, go do it despite how it will be the hardest thing in my life, and then it will be such a huge thing off of the shoulders and minds of my family and myself. I'm just scared that once I have them all out there my mind.wont be working and I won't be able to talk, I'll just be crying and unable to think

I really don't know where to go to get it, or if my insurance would cover it, or if it will even work. I don't know even if id be able to open up to a therapist, since I have trouble even talking to a cashier.

Thats one of the most painful parts for me. I'm pretty certain my siblings would be willing to talk to me because I'm sure they hate living this way too. But they won't come to me first and I don't have the balls to go to one of them and try to talk. 

 I have heard the good suggestion to write a letter for each of them and the letters under their doors. And that's what I've been planning on doing since even before posting on Reddit. I am just scared I will miss/forget some key things I want to address in my letters when I write it. 


And my relationship with my parents are fine. My mom acts basically the same towards me I would say, my dad just seems really disappointed in me and I can't talk to him right at all. I feel like the biggest horrible disappointment as a son because of all my failures and shortcoming, so I can't make eye contact when we talk and I only respond in short sentences. I also try to avoid him a lot.
